policy.definition: Coupled services are passenger-visible split/join train operations: two named portions with different names, destinations, or service systems run physically coupled on a shared segment and split or join at a station.
excluded: ordinary car-count changes without separate passenger-facing train portions
temporary seasonal split/join operations not in regular passenger timetable

displayRule.coupledToUncoupledDirection: Show one umbrella train row named with the Japanese middle dot, for example A・B. After the user selects it, show the individual portions as a second selection step before showing alighting stations.
displayRule.uncoupledToCoupledDirection: Show the portions as normal separate trains.
displayRule.sameTrainRule: During the shared coupled segment, all portions in the same coupled physical group count as same_train for capture.

methodology.knownSeeds: Check known Japanese split/join coupled-service families from reviewed research notes.
genericScan: Index all timetable stops by station group and stop time.
Pair different service labels at the same station within maxGapSec.
Keep candidates when they share the previous station and diverge after, converge to the same next station from different previous stations, or have matching train-number evidence.
methodology.limitation: This audit finds candidates and gaps; it does not yet create coupledServiceGroups for gameplay.
